thread:
zoe: Prototyping folded authz at the edge to cut RPS. Quick ask: how do we keep billing and audit precise if we collapse many requests into one auth call?

nate: Must preserve per-request attribution. My vote: edge assigns per-item ids and includes minimal metadata (org, project, sa, token_hash) in a compact envelope.

quinn: Envelope pattern is fine. Important: auth service should emit quota events per-item, not per-envelope. Also include per-item idempotency keys to prevent double-counting on retries.

zoe: Good call. For telemetry, edge writes a single compressed envelope and telemetry pipeline expands to N billing events asynchronously. This keeps edge IO low but preserves downstream granularity.

auth-bot: (automated) Policy note: token_hash allowed, raw tokens must NOT be logged. See internal policy link.

nate: Console UX: show folded totals by default with an "Expand batch" drilldown that fetches expanded events by trace_id. Add trace_id + decision_ids to audit entries so compliance teams can reconcile.

quinn: Rollout plan: canary 1-5%, mirror expanded events, compare billing parity metrics for 24h. Metric to watch: "expanded_vs_envelope_quota_delta". Auto-fallback to per-request authz if delta > threshold.

zoe: I'll draft envelope schema and PR. Nate & Quinn: please add idempotency scheme and runbook for oncall. Ping #eng-platform when draft ready. :thumbsup:
